Customs

Tracciato di audit

A documented and verifiable chronological record of all actions, transactions, and communications related to customs clearance and regulatory compliance for a shipment.

Quick answer

Why it matters

Tracciato di audit matters because it supports clear communication in Customs contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Tracciato di audit?

In this glossary, Tracciato di audit refers to: A documented and verifiable chronological record of all actions, transactions, and communications related to customs clearance and regulatory compliance for a shipment.

How is Tracciato di audit used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Un tracciato elettronico di audit di tutte le dichiarazioni doganali è necessario per la verifica della conformità e l’ispezione normativa."

Why does Tracciato di audit matter in logistics?

Tracciato di audit matters because it supports clear communication in Customs contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Who uses Tracciato di audit?

Tracciato di audit is mainly used by Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers.

What category does Tracciato di audit belong to?

In this glossary, Tracciato di audit is grouped under Customs. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

A documented and verifiable chronological record of all actions, transactions, and communications related to customs clearance and regulatory compliance for a shipment.

Operational example

An electronic audit trail of all customs submissions is required for compliance verification and regulatory inspection.
